welcome.text:
ANONYMOUS LOVE

Anonymous dating for a man and a woman, without a phone number or extra personal data.
You must be 18+. Anonymity inside the bot does not remove your responsibility for what you send or save.
age.confirm_under: Confirm again: are you under 18? A dating profile will not be created.
age.rejected: This service is only for people 18+. Dating is unavailable.
rules.title: Rules and privacy
rules.text:
The short version:
• 18+ only
• a man is matched with a woman, and the other way around
• no threats, blackmail, extortion, stalking, publishing someone else's data, or any sexual content involving minors
• photos, usernames and links open after profile review and the other person's consent
• identity review does not claim that one photo proves gender or age
• the bot does not promise absolute secrecy: do not send what you would not want to exist outside the chat
• reports are reviewed by a moderator, and you can delete the account
rules.declined: You cannot continue without the rules.
gender.prompt: Who are you on this service?

interests.prompt: Pick at least 3 interests. Now: {count}. Free accounts can pick up to {limit}.
interests.limit: Interest limit: {limit}. VIP can use every topic.
nickname.prompt: Choose a nickname, 3–24 characters. Your real name is not required.
bio.prompt: A short bio, up to 300 characters. No links or @username.
bio.invalid: The bio must be 1 to 300 characters.
bio.link_blocked: Links in the bio are available only to a reviewed profile, and dangerous addresses stay blocked.
age_range.prompt: What age range do you want?
search_prefs.prompt: How should we look for someone?
registration.done: Profile ready. {amount} LoveCoins were added. These are internal bonuses, not money.
menu.title: Main menu
search.queued: Looking for someone. If nobody matches right now, the bot will connect you when a suitable person is free. Search again or stop.
search.none: Nobody matches right now. Change the filters or try later.
search.already: You already have an active conversation.
search.paused: Search is paused. Turn it on in settings.
search.hidden: Your profile is hidden. Show it again in settings.
search.need_coins: Not enough LoveCoins for extra filters. VIP uses them without this fee.
search.filters_note: Language and country filters are paid on a regular profile. VIP does not remove age limits or review.

chat.partner_left: The other person left the conversation.
chat.help_text:
In chat you can send text, stickers and reactions.
Photos, links and a username open after both profiles are reviewed.
/stop ends the chat, /next looks for another person.
Do not send money to strangers.
chat.interests_body:
In common: {shared}
Profile score: {score}. This is not a compatibility guarantee.
chat.blocked_done: Blocked. You will not be matched again.
chat.partner_blocked: The other person ended the chat and blocked you.
verify.intro:
Profile review is required for photos, a username and links.
First send a regular photo, then a round video message. An administrator reviews both and confirms the request.
One photo does not by itself prove gender or age. Documents and biometrics are not stored.
verify.locked: This is available after profile confirmation. Verify to exchange photos, reveal a Telegram username and share links
verify.code:
Put this code in the caption of one live selfie: {code}
The code should be visible in the photo or the caption. Reused photos are rejected.
verify.need_photo: First send a regular photo in this chat.
verify.need_video: Photo received. Now send a round video message.
verify.submitted: The request was sent to an administrator. They will confirm the photo and the video message.
verify.pending: The request is waiting for materials.
verify.approved: Profile confirmed. The badge is visible only when profiles are mutually revealed.
verify.rejected: The review was declined. You can submit a new request.
verify.duplicate: This photo was already used on another request.
verify.provider_missing: An external review provider is not connected. Manual moderator review is available.
verify.choose: How do you want to verify?
verify.external_started:
Open the provider page: {url}
The bot confirms a profile only after a signed provider result.
reveal.sent: Request sent. Nothing opens without the other person's consent.
reveal.incoming: Your match asks to reveal profiles. A username is shared only if it exists and the setting allows it.
reveal.done: The profile is open to both of you.
reveal.declined: The other person declined the reveal.
reveal.revoked: Reveal consent was withdrawn. Anything already saved outside the bot cannot be pulled back.
reveal.need: Reveal is available in an active chat between two reviewed profiles.
reveal.disabled: Reveal is turned off in settings.
reveal.no_username: Telegram username is hidden or missing.
media.intro: Photos go only to the current match and only if both profiles are confirmed. The bot does not publish them. Telegram cannot promise to block every possible bypass.
media.blocked: This media type is not forwarded in anonymous chat.
media.rules: This photo is only for this chat. Do not save or forward it without consent.
media.limit: Too many photos. Wait a moment.
media.unsupported: This message type is not supported.

pay.title: Top up LoveCoins

vip.title: VIP
vip.benefits:
VIP includes:
• language and country filters without a separate fee
• every interest
• a larger daily bonus
• extra gifts
VIP does not remove the 18+ rule, review, blocks or reports. Photos and reports are not sold.
referral.title: Invite friends to ANONYMOUS LOVE and receive LoveCoins for active members
referral.body: The full bonus arrives after the invited profile is reviewed, not merely for opening the link. This is not income and not a cash-out.

tasks.not_ready: This task is not complete yet.
tasks.answer_qotd: Answer the question of the day
gifts.title: Gifts in the current chat
gifts.off: The other person turned gifts off.
favorites.title: Favorites

favorites.incoming: Your match wants to add you to favorites.
favorites.added: You are now favorites for each other.
rematch.prompt: Do you want to keep talking with this person?
rematch.wait: Saved. If the other person agrees too, a safe request will arrive. A username is not sent automatically.
rematch.both: You both want to continue. You can open a new anonymous chat without exchanging usernames.
settings.title: Settings
settings.hide_off: Profile is visible in search again
settings.username_on: Username can be shown on reveal
help.text:
Commands:
/start — menu
/profile — profile
/search — search
/stop — end chat
/verify — verification
/balance — balance
/referral — invites
/settings — settings
/help — help
/delete_account — delete

Report and block are available in an active chat. A moderator sees only the reported message, not the whole history.
You can appeal a mistaken block.
report.choose: Why are you reporting? An unconfirmed report does not by itself ban a person.
delete.ask: Delete the profile? Messages and review photos will be removed. The bonus ledger stays without the name and Telegram ID.
delete.done: Account deleted. /start begins again without a second registration bonus.
appeal.ask: Describe why the block should be reviewed.
errors.rate_limit: Too many requests. Wait a moment.
errors.private_only: The bot works only in a private chat.
safety.blocked: Message not sent: this content is prohibited. The account is limited until a moderator decides.
safety.partner: The conversation was stopped because of prohibited content.
scam.warn: Be careful: do not send money or card details.
game.title: Guess your match
game.start: Three short questions. Answers stay between you and are shown only after both of you answer.
game.wait: Answer saved. Waiting for the other person.
